note: Submodule of registration. One config object registration_purger.settings with four booleans: purge_registration_on_delete (default true), purge_registration_settings_on_delete (true), purge_registration_on_update (false), purge_registration_settings_on_update (false). Hooks entity_delete/entity_update call registration_purger.purger. Cases are grounded in that config object.

evals.prompt: What does the Registration Purger submodule do by default when a host entity (e.g. an event node) is deleted?
evals.expected_output: By default (purge_registration_on_delete and purge_registration_settings_on_delete both true) it deletes that host's registrations and its registration_settings entity when the host is deleted, preventing orphaned data.

evals.prompt: Which config object and keys control the Registration Purger, and what are their default values?
evals.expected_output: registration_purger.settings with purge_registration_on_delete (true), purge_registration_settings_on_delete (true), purge_registration_on_update (false), purge_registration_settings_on_update (false).

evals.prompt: How do you make Registration Purger also delete a host's registrations when the host is edited so that registration is disabled (not only when the host is deleted)?
evals.expected_output: Set purge_registration_on_update (and/or purge_registration_settings_on_update) to true in registration_purger.settings; these default to false and cover the entity_update path where registration becomes disabled.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the Registration Purger configuration and state whether it currently purges a host's registrations when the host is updated to disable registration (the on-update behaviour).
On this site, configure Registration Purger so that when a host entity is updated to disable registration, its registrations are automatically deleted. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: registration_purger.settings.purge_registration_on_update = true (set it via config factory and save).
